image_description: A high-angle, wide shot of an ornate church interior featuring a central altar. The altar is a rectangular structure draped in a light blue cloth with white trim, positioned in the foreground. Behind it rises a massive, multi-tiered altarpiece (reredos) made of stone or plaster, featuring niches, statues (including a central figure of Jesus), and decorative columns. The architecture includes arched alcoves, religious paintings, and warm ambient lighting from wall sconces. To the left and right are architectural elements like pillars and balconies.
